question: In the study of the solvent-to-feed-gas ratio, over what range was the steam mass flow rate varied, and over what ratio range?
question_long: In the isoprene recovery simulation's study of the solvent-to-feed-gas ratio, over what range was the steam mass flow rate varied, and over what ratio range?
rendered: According to the document, the steam mass flow rate was varied in Figure 7, which shows how the solvent-to-feed gas ratio affects steam use for three feed gas flow rates: 800 kg h^− 1, 1500 kg h^− 1, and 3000 kg h^− 1, at 1 wt % isoprene concentration.
